workdir.description: Working directory for intermediate files and temporary artifacts

architectures.description: List of architectures to consider (e.g., amd64, i386, arm64). Must include at least one native arch.

archive_root.description: Absolute path to the root of the Debian archive (where dists/ and pool/ reside)

use_stable_testing_only.description: If true, only consider 'stable' and 'testing' suites for metadata and bootstrap analysis

exclude_packages.description: List of shell-glob-style patterns to exclude from source package processing

max_parallel_downloads.description: Maximum number of parallel HTTP connections for fetching Packages/Sources files

dose_config.description: Path to custom dose3 config file for dose-builddebcheck/dose-distcheck wrappers

include_arch_all_fvs.description: If true, include arch:all packages in feedback vertex set computation

build_order_output.description: Path where build orders are written (used by botch-build-order-from-zero, botch-build-fixpoint)

verbose.description: If true, emit verbose progress output from most tools
